name: Jerbolt
look: a tiny floating yellow jerboa with hypnotic spiral eyes, long red-rimmed ears, big red-brown feet and an excessively long tail curled into a turning yellow-and-violet ring round it, tipped with a lightning bolt
entry: It floats over desert dunes at night with its tail curled round it in a ring. Anything that stares at the turning ring for long falls into a daze, and Jerbolt hops off with its food.
how: Wild: uncommon in deserts, badlands and savannas at night.
Evolves into Mesmerboa when a Thunder Stone is used on it.
